description: Refrigerator, warranty expires in 45 days (April 28) — high risk

input.document_text: Warranty Service Request — Priority. Product: Godrej 236L Frost Free Refrigerator (Model RF EON 236B 25 HI). Customer: Sreedevi Nambiar. Purchase Date: 2024-04-28. Warranty Duration: 2 years. Warranty Expiry: 2026-04-28. Date of Claim: 2026-03-14. Remaining Warranty Period: 45 days. Fault: Refrigerator completely stopped cooling. Freezer compartment at room temperature. All food items spoiled. Motor appears to be running but no cooling. Likely compressor failure. This is the second compressor issue — first replaced under warranty in October 2025.
